description: Use the run-workflow MCP to discover, compose, execute, publish, and save Firefly workflows. TRIGGER when: user asks what the MCP can do; wants to process images/video/3D models (.usdz/.glb) via workflow; wants to build/run/save/publish a workflow; wants to list/view saved or recent workflows, presets/interfaces, or Quickstart workflows (e.g. 'run banners at scale'); pastes any workflow/batch/execution ID. Create/compose requests default to compose_workflow from scratch. Call get_featured_workflow ONLY when explicitly asked for a featured/predefined template. Bare 'run banners at scale' = QUICKSTART (list_golden_workflows). BARE ID = INSPECT ONLY — call inspect_run, never run_workflow_submit. ALWAYS call list_actions first for action/node discovery; a "what tools" question is answered directly from your visible tool list, no call. DO NOT TRIGGER for direct Firefly API calls without MCP (use firefly-api-specs).
